parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: The KV pair's key: letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, such as last_loaded_date.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: What to set it to. Kestra keeps 42 as a number, true as a switch, 2026-01-31 as a date and {"a": 1} as JSON, unless you save it as text.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Whether Kestra reads what the value is, or keeps it as text.
parameters.name: value_type

parameters.description: Delete it after this many hours. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: expires_in_hours

created.description: Whether it was made, there being none with that key

revision.description: Its revision: 1, then one more each time it's set

type.description: What Kestra keeps it as: STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATETIME, DATE, DURATION or JSON

value.description: Its value: text, a number, a switch, a date, a list or an object

value_text.description: Its value as text: text as it is, anything else as JSON

wait_for_execution.description: Wait until an execution ends (succeeds, fails, ends with warnings or is killed) or pauses for someone, up to 15 minutes, then get it with its outputs. One still going when the wait is up carries on in Kestra.
wait_for_execution.name: wait_for_execution

parameters.description: The execution's ID: pick a recent one, or use the id of an earlier step, such as Execute flow's.
parameters.name: execution_id

parameters.description: How long to wait, 1 to 15 minutes. Defaults to 5.
parameters.name: max_wait_minutes

duration_seconds.description: How long it has run, in seconds

end_date.description: When it ended (ISO 8601); empty until it does

failed_tasks.description: The IDs of the tasks that failed

finished.description: Whether it has ended: succeeded, failed, ended with warnings, or was killed or cancelled

flow_revision.description: The revision of the flow it runs

link.description: A link to the execution in Kestra

namespace.description: The flow's namespace, such as company.team

original_id.description: The execution it was first, if it was restarted

outputs.description: The flow's outputs, once it has ended; empty before

parent_id.description: The execution that started it as a subflow; empty if none

state.description: Its state: CREATED, QUEUED, RUNNING, PAUSED, RESTARTED, KILLING, SUCCESS, WARNING, FAILED, KILLED, CANCELLED, RETRIED or SKIPPED

state_since.description: When it came into its state (ISO 8601)

task_runs.description: Its task runs, in the order they started

attempts.description: How many times it was tried

duration_seconds.description: How long it ran, in seconds

end_date.description: When it ended (ISO 8601); empty until it does

state.description: The task run's state, such as SUCCESS, RUNNING or FAILED

task_id.description: The task's ID in the flow, such as extract

value.description: The item it ran for, inside a loop; empty otherwise

timed_out.description: Whether the wait ran out before it ended or paused

trigger_type.description: What started it, such as io.kestra.plugin.core.trigger.Schedule; empty when a person or the API did

waited_seconds.description: How long the step waited, in seconds

description: Run your Kestra flows: execute flows with inputs and wait for them, restart, kill, pause, resume and replay executions, read their logs and outputs, save flows from YAML, set KV pairs, send to webhooks, and start a workflow when an execution fails, succeeds or is stuck.

kestra_execution_failed_trigger.description: Runs when an execution fails, ends with warnings or is killed, of every flow, a namespace or one flow. One restarted and failing again starts it again. Executions that ended before the workflow was turned on don't.

parameters.description: Only executions in this namespace and those inside it, such as company.team. Leave blank for every namespace.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: Only executions of the flow with this ID, such as nightly_load. Leave blank for every flow.
parameters.name: flow_id

parameters.description: Which end states start it, separated by commas: Failed, Warning, Killed or Cancelled. Leave blank for Failed, Warning and Killed.
parameters.name: states

kestra_execution_stuck_trigger.description: Runs when an execution has been running, paused, queued or waiting to start for longer than you choose, such as a load that usually takes ten minutes still running after an hour.

parameters.description: Only executions in this namespace and those inside it, such as company.team. Leave blank for every namespace.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: Only executions of the flow with this ID, such as nightly_load. Leave blank for every flow.
parameters.name: flow_id

parameters.description: The state it's stuck in: Running, Paused, Queued or Created. Leave blank for Running.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: How many minutes in that state count as stuck, such as 60. Leave blank for 60.
parameters.name: minutes

kestra_execution_succeeded_trigger.description: Runs when an execution succeeds, of every flow, a namespace or one flow. Executions that ended before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only executions in this namespace and those inside it, such as company.team. Leave blank for every namespace.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: Only executions of the flow with this ID, such as nightly_load. Leave blank for every flow.
parameters.name: flow_id
